title: Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-Language Streams for Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding

problems.name: Spatio-Temporal and Object/Event-Level Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-Language Streams for Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG) aims to localize the target object spatially and temporally according to the given language query.

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: In this work, we propose a novel framework in which a static vision-language stream and a dynamic vision-language stream are developed to collaboratively reason the target tube.

problems.name: LLM Temporal Reasoning and Time Output Instability
problems.evidence_sentence: We further design a novel cross-stream collaborative block between the two streams, which enables the static and dynamic streams to transfer useful and complementary information from each other to achieve collaborative reasoning.

methods.name: Object/Event/Spatio-Temporal Modules
methods.evidence_sentence: Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-Language Streams for Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG) aims to localize the target object spatially and temporally according to the given language query.

methods.name: Contrastive or Cross-Modal Alignment
methods.evidence_sentence: The static stream performs cross-modal understanding in a single frame and learns to attend to the target object spatially according to intra-frame visual cues like object appearances.

methods.name: LLM Reasoning, Agentic Workflows, or RL Post-Training
methods.evidence_sentence: We further design a novel cross-stream collaborative block between the two streams, which enables the static and dynamic streams to transfer useful and complementary information from each other to achieve collaborative reasoning.
